title: Remove TermAl's temporary evaluation hash fallback after Engram removes the alias
outcome: After Engram's final evaluation-id projection has landed, TermAl reads evaluation record IDs only from evaluation and removes its temporary live-reader hash fallback without rewriting stored history or changing genuine fingerprint fields.
acceptance: The holder records Engram's landed hash-alias removal (w-a18b2a42c5ac), its commit/build and producer confirmation, before this fallback-removal implementation starts; the preceding TermAl evaluation-preferring reader has already landed and run after Greg's restart.

The live Engram evaluation-ID reader and receipt extraction use evaluation only. Focused tests show evaluation-only receipts retain the exact record ID, hash-only live receipts cannot supply it, and supersedes/carried record references and genuine content/source fingerprints are unchanged. Stored historical records are not rewritten.
The exact input passes the maintained full gate and required independent review; documentation removes the temporary live-protocol fallback and records the final supported producer contract.
disposal_reason: Continue as independent work: the parent w-db79f9d58072 is completed, and the Engram prerequisite has landed.
